items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: The guy was named Leonard something; he was trying to learn.

ctx.x: ...in the shop there. So he said, "Yeah, I could use you on the saxophone, and pay you twenty-one dollars a week." I said, "Well, the only thing is, I don't have a saxophone." He said, "That saxophone don't belong to you?" I said, "I had to borrow this thing from..." The guy was named Leonard something; he was trying to learn. And Doc Moon said, "Well, if that's all it takes, when we get to Lafayette, I'll buy you a saxophone, and then you can pay me back." Lafayette, Louisiana was only maybe fifteen miles from…
So we go to Lafayette, to this music store, and buy this alto saxophone. They had one in there, a Conn, nickel-plated alto saxophone -- it cost ninety-nine dollars.
